checks_run: purpose: every shot names a purpose and a reason
fit: the camera fits the shot purpose
rhythm: shot lengths vary, cut rate fits the style, framings vary

findings.problem: four shots in a row have almost the same length
findings.expected: neighbouring shots differ by at least 25 %
findings.fix: Lengthen or shorten one of them

findings.problem: cut rate 2.6 per 10 s, the style's references use 0.3
findings.fix: Merge shots or hold longer with in-frame changes

findings.problem: same framing and angle three shots in a row
findings.expected: change the angle when the meaning changes

notes: Taste (is this camera choice the best one?) needs eyes: watch the render frames (tools/reference/watch.mjs) and the vision critics.
